entities.summary: Jacqueline "Jacqui" Frazier-Lyde is an American lawyer and former professional boxer. She is the daughter of former world Heavyweight boxing champion Joe Frazier. In January 2000, at the age of 38, Frazier announced that she would begin participating in the sport of boxing. Frazier-Lyde was inducted into the International Women's Boxing Hall of Fame in 2024.
